title: MLINE-referenced simple LTYPE with three ordered APPID XDATA groups

scope.source: Runtime-generated DXF; no repository drawing fixture is used or added.
scope.cross_product: Both source encodings were exported to both output encodings.
scope.linetype: EditDash, two simple dash segments [1.0, -0.5], declared length 1.5, source flags 0, alignment 65.

documents.title: DXF Group Codes in Numerical Order Reference
documents.relevant_rule: Group 1001 names the registered application that begins an XDATA group; group 1000 carries a string value.

implementation.change: The selected simple-LTYPE XDATA path admits up to three distinct ordered APPID groups. It binds each typed group-1001 name to its exact physical source slot and unique source-bound bare APPID record; checks distinct canonical names and output table identities; and retains existing work/byte budgets. A fourth APPID group remains refused by the selected profile cap.
implementation.preserved_contract: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. APPID metadata, earlier versions and application-specific XDATA meaning remain outside this profile.

proof.source: The three distinct APPID names and three following string payloads are exact and ordered in physical XDATA, typed readback, and source-bound bare APPID records.
proof.output: All four ASCII/binary input/output combinations preserve exact physical XDATA order and payloads. Fresh import confirms all three typed pairs and exactly one emitted record for each APPID provider. Internal binding checks prove all provider source handles and LTYPE identity.
proof.failure_retry: Removing the third APPID provider refuses export and preserves the destination for all four output combinations; restoring the provider succeeds on the same adapter. A late third-provider name mutation refuses atomically for ASCII and binary output; restoring the original name succeeds on the same adapter with exact output and readback.

limits: This qualifies only three distinct bare APPID providers, each followed by one group-1000 string, in one AC1027 simple-LTYPE XDATA profile. Four or more APPIDs, repeated provider names, metadata-bearing providers, other payload orders/compositions, LTYPE schemas, versions and application meaning remain unqualified.
The evidence proves transport and source/output identity only. It does not establish MLINE rendering, recursive document closure or general format support.
next: Choose the next bounded P2 source/schema witness. Four-or-more APPID groups and other XDATA compositions remain open; prefer a distinct payload order or a generalized provider-count design only when its memory/work bound and exact output oracle are ready.
